author: benaye
body:
After Twix's failure in T4 I decided to abandon it and look for another team.

Skype: Don't have, don't use.
Timezone: Australian Eastern Daylight Time (Victoria, Australia)
Position: Can do anything assigned to me
Cannoning: Whip, Icarus but learning more
Can you speed bridge? Ninja bridge and breezily (still mastering it so probably will fail)
How good are my communication skills? I'm decently active on TS and have a working microphone.
Activeness: I play Minecraft a lot and from the 7th to the 2nd of February next year I'm on holidays.
Are you good with a bow and sword? Decent with both but could be a lot better if I can improve my shitty aim.
Will I be able to attend tournaments? Sadly, probably not because I'm someone who needs sleep are the tourneys are at like 1-4am for me.

Thanks for reading.

Ben
